chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Muhammad ibn Khalid, from Al-Nadr ibn Suwayd, from Abdullah ibn Sinan, who said:

Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) said: 'Allah preferred Friday over other days, and indeed the Gardens are adorned and decorated on Friday for those who attend it, and you will race towards Paradise according to your racing towards Friday, and indeed the gates of the sky are opened for the ascension of the deeds of the servants.'
ai.seo_question: What are the spiritual merits and rewards of attending Friday prayers according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: In this narration from al-Kafi, Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) elucidates the metaphysical elevation of Friday, describing how Paradise is adorned for its attendees and linking the swiftness of one's entry into Jannah to their eagerness in attending the congregational prayer. This highlights the Shia emphasis on Friday as a unique temporal portal where the gates of heaven open for the ascension of deeds, reinforcing the day's status as the 'chief of days' in Islamic cosmology. The hadith underscores the spiritual merit of communal worship and the divine reward structure tied specifically to this weekly observance.

en.hubeali: Muhammad in Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Muhammad Bin Khalid, from Al Nazar Bin Suweyd, from Abdullah Bin Sinan who said,

‘Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Preferred the Friday over the others from the days and that the Gardens (of Paradise) are decorated and adorned on the day of Friday for the ones who come to it, and you all would be preceding to the Paradise upon a measurement of your preceding to the Friday; and that the Gates of the skies are opened for the ascension of the deeds of the servants’.
en.sarwar: 9. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Muhammad ibn Khalid from al-Nadr ibn al-Suwayd from ‘Abd Allah ibn Sinan who has said the following:

“Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘Allah has given excellence to Friday over other days. On Friday, decoration and beautification takes place in paradise for those who attend it (Friday). You race to paradise proportionate to the degree of your attending Friday. On Friday the doors of heavens open for the deeds of servants (of Allah).”’
